item.title: City Commission to consider tax breaks for 121-unit west Lawrence affordable housing project
item.description: Lawrence city commissioners on Tuesday will hold a public hearing and consider tax breaks for a 121-unit permanently affordable housing project that's slated for K-10 and Bob Billings. Continue reading ...

item.title: One side of street, sidewalk closed on section of 24th Street in eastern Lawrence
item.description: City contractors are blocking some traffic and closing part of a sidewalk for a storm sewer replacement project along 24th Street in southeastern Lawrence. Continue reading ...

item.title: Student-curated collections on Indigenous literature, human connection with ecology to launch at KU
item.description: A dual exhibition will celebrate two new student-curated collections at KU Libraries focused on contemporary Indigenous literature and human connection to the flora and fauna of China and Japan. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence High School student artists shine in regional competition, advance to nationals
item.description: Lawrence High School students are celebrating success in a prestigious regional art competition, and many of their works will advance to the national level. Continue reading ...

item.title: De Soto Panasonic battery plant nearing 50% production, second wing underway
item.description: Panasonic’s Kansas battery plant will ramp up to 50% of its production capacity in the next few months, a company executive said Monday. Continue reading ...

item.title: Former KU professor to give talk on biography of George ‘Nash’ Walker
item.description: A former KU professor will give a talk on his new book, a biography on the trailblazing Black performer George “Nash” Walker who spent formative years in Lawrence. Continue reading ...

item.title: CoreCivic receives Leavenworth planning commission approval in contentious meeting
item.description: CoreCivic is a step closer to reopening its private prison in Leavenworth as a lucrative immigration detention center after the city planning commission approved a special use permit over objections from local advocates. Continue reading ...

item.title: Fundraisers for the Lawrence Arts Center offer a smorgasbord of culinary-themed creations
item.description: As football fans gear up for the 60th Super Bowl, Lawrencians are readying their utensils for an annual soup and ceramics jubilee. The Lawrence Arts Center's Souper Bowl is set for Saturday. Continue reading ...

item.title: City Commission pledges tax breaks for west Lawrence affordable housing project
item.description: A majority of Lawrence city commissioners on Tuesday pledged their support for tax breaks to offset development costs of an affordable housing project planned for the far western edge of town. Continue reading ...
